issues.description: The tensor-network simulate_ghz_state function in the template is missing the 'shots' parameter while the problem statement and solution expect simulate_ghz_state(num_qubits, shots). The template's simulate_ghz_state references 'shots' in its docstring and body (assertions) even though it is not declared as a parameter, which will cause NameError/implementation confusion and prevents students from matching the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template function signature to include the shots parameter (def simulate_ghz_state(num_qubits: int, shots: int) -> dict[str, int]:), update the docstring and assertions to match, and ensure the body uses the shots parameter consistently so the template API matches the problem statement and solution.
